_comment: Sound effects and music from the user's installation. effects: sound numbers in SND/Siedler3_00.dat (docs/formate/snd.md; one of the sound's variants is picked at random – or, written as { "sound": n, "variants": [...] }, one of those), strike per soldier type (an object named after a people overrides it for that people), death per people (default for the others), treeFalls when a tree is felled, buildingFalls when a building comes down, spell when a priest begins one, healing when a healer begins, claiming when a pioneer begins a border post, geologistFinds when a geologist marks at least minAmount (0-15 per field), sowing per trade when a worker begins to sow; command when the player gives soldiers an order, ui for the panel (up/down: orders and shares one more or fewer, toggle: on/off switches, workArea: work area moved, demolish: the tear-down icon clicked), events for a new message (combat or any other); these are heard as from the middle of the screen. Numbers picked by ear from the original. volume: loudness per kind (0-1, times the player's setting). maxVoices: effects playing at once; perFrame: the same sound started at most this often in one frame (a big battle would otherwise be one roar). hearing: sounds outside the view fade out until this many half view widths/heights from its center.
_gainComment: Recordings much quieter than the rest, amplified this many times when loaded (by sound number; a volume cannot go above 1): the swamp's blub.
_workComment: Working outside, per activity: the sound plays when the work animation reaches 'at' (0-1) of each of its rounds, so it keeps time with the picture. workshops: while the worker works inside, the building sounds every 'everySeconds' (a little at random).
_ambienceComment: Sounds of the land in view, by its ground (terrain names as in TerrainType). The view is sampled every sampleStep fields (and margin half view sizes beyond its edges, where a field counts less and less); a kind is as loud as its share of the samples, full from fullShare, times volume, gliding there in fadeSeconds – so the sea fades quickly as the view leaves the coast. Unexplored ground under the fog is silent. With overlap, one variant follows the other without a pause (the next starts this many seconds before the last ends), panned towards where the ground lies; with everySeconds (min, max), single calls now and then from one field of that ground (at least minShare of the view). bubbles: swamp bubbles (file 1, sequences 106-108) rise on these grounds (the green swamp, not the brown mud), on average one per field every perFieldSeconds; the bursting ones sound.
_musicComment: Background music: MUSIC/TrackNN.ogg (the former CD audio tracks), starting with the first of the own people's list, then shuffled from it (all tracks if the player turns that off), pauseSeconds (min, max) of silence between two pieces, fadeSeconds to fade out when the list changes. Tracks per people assigned by ear by the project owner.
